fuel_consumption.source_quote: The Company expects to consume approximately 2.1 billion gallons of jet fuel in 2018.

instrument_type_details.notes: Per Note 10: primarily uses a mixture of purchased call options, collar structures, call spreads, put spreads, and fixed price swap agreements. Portfolio covers 2018-2021+. Net fair value at 12/31/2017 was a net asset of $248 million (designated hedges: $248M asset, $20M liability; non-designated: $35M asset, $37M liability). Cash collateral held from counterparties: $15 million.

warnings: MD&A hedge table is dated as of January 19, 2018 (not December 31, 2017); reflects forward-looking coverage.
Note 10 gallon volumes are maximum economic hedge and may vary significantly as market prices fluctuate.
2021 volumes in Note 10 are grouped as 'Beyond 2020' (315M gal); pct from MD&A footnote is approximately 11%.
All volume figures are in gallons (millions) as required.
